title: FBI Freedom of Information Act Request  Alfredo Bernard Shaw Informant and Cross Reference Records (Department of Justice, Office of the Attorney General)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, 5 U.S.C. § 552, I hereby request the following records:

All FBI records concerning Alfredo Bernard Shaw, also known as Alfredo B. Shaw and Bernard Shaw, including records indexed or cross-referenced under:

* FBI confidential-source identifier 938188EA7
* MPD informant number 1069
* SCSO informant number 2282
* FBI files 282A-ME-50216 and 282B-ME-52439
* Shelby County Criminal Court case number 94-07204
* Tony Von Carruthers
* The alleged alias “Jake Wright”

Please search the FBI Central Records System, Universal Index, Memphis Field Office files, confidential-source systems, investigative-fund and payment systems, task-force files, emails and attachments, archived systems, paper records, and cross-references from January 1, 1985, through the date this request is processed.

This request includes source-registration, activation, deactivation, validation, suitability, reliability, contact, debriefing, FD-302, payment, reward, expense, benefit, promise, immunity, cooperation, charge-disposition, prosecutor-communication, dissemination, and interagency records.

Please include the complete June 10, 1998 FD-302 associated with Special Agent William C. Rasmussen, including continuation pages, attachments, interview notes, routing records, indexing entries, and records identifying every agency or prosecutor who received it.

Please also produce records showing whether information about Shaw’s informant status, payments, benefits, credibility, reliability, or law-enforcement relationships was communicated to Memphis police, the Shelby County Sheriff’s Office, Shelby County prosecutors, the Tennessee Bureau of Investigation, CrimeStoppers, the Shelby County Justice Review Unit, or defense counsel.

If any material is withheld, please identify the applicable FOIA exemption and release every reasonably segregable nonexempt portion. If responsive records were transferred or destroyed, please identify the receiving custodian or applicable records-disposition authority.

I request electronic production and advance notice before fees exceed $25.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Donald R. Askew Jr.

title: Federal Agency Data Sharing and ICE Access — Flock Safety Data — Village of Hempstead

communications.communication:

title: Flock Aerodome Drone as First Responder Program — Contracts, Authorizations, and Operations — Village of Hempstead

communications.communication:

1. All contracts, agreements, addenda, or amendments between the Village of Hempstead or the Hempstead Village Police Department and Flock Safety, Inc. related to the DFR program, including the Flock Aerodome system, drone hardware, software, and any associated services. All policies, procedures, or written guidelines governing deployment of DFR drones, including: triggering conditions for deployment, airspace and altitude restrictions, data retention policies for drone footage, and any privacy impact assessments conducted prior to or following program launch.

4. All drone deployment logs from the date of first operational flight to the date of this request, including date, time, triggering event, geographic area covered, and duration of each flight.

5. A complete inventory of drone docking stations installed within the Village of Hempstead, including installation locations and dates.
